MAPTM.notes: The THC figures are from the One Line January 2025 set at 3% regional tax, which the note says is the most usable but not confirmed as current; a second 4% set (export 20ft MAD 1,340, 40ft MAD 2,240; import 20ft MAD 1,560, 40ft MAD 2,500) exists and the choice between sets is unresolved. All THC figures exclude VAT of 20% and regional tax. The OOCL 40ft figures (2,447 and 3,997 MAD), the Hapag-Lloyd THC cell ('Included'), and the CMA CGM 2021 reefer THC (MAD 2068.48) were not used. No current 2026 THC was found, and no ISPS fee in MAD or EUR from a Moroccan or carrier source was found. Port fee amount was not given in the extract. The Hapag-Lloyd equipment transfer charge is not labelled Tanger-specific. Lacking a confirmed date for the Hapag-Lloyd gate-in charge, it is shown without one.

GBLGP.notes: The £196.13 figure is a single combined line for full import and full export lifts, so the same value is shown against both directions; no separate export THC was found. Figures are from search extracts, not opened PDFs. Gate out/in of £65.33 per container is noted but not mapped to the THC fields. The £181.86 v13 figure appears superseded but is undated. Terminal SSR admin fees conflict (£70.73 versus £35.47) and are excluded. No current ISPS export figure was found; the 2021 £5.50 is not treated as current. Demurrage and detention on the 15 June 2026 sheet have an unclear column mapping and are excluded. The Hapag-Lloyd GBP 5.9 figure has no unit or size and is excluded. The forwarder sheet's applies value of both is an assumption. The PLA £4.30 is unverified. Confirm against DP World's current public tariff and the carrier's local charges tariff.
